name: creatio-demo-scenario-writer-skills
description: Turn a solution consultant's Creatio demo case — notes, a scenario or discovery material — into two files: a narrative scenario they present from, and an object model with pages and seed data for the build agent. Writes everything in one pass, closes every gap in the step logic with the best-fitting step and hands it over as numbered proposals instead of questions, reads the existing instance first, then revises both files from the consultant's feedback. Loses no detail of the source.
